reviews.title: Easy Install and Great Performance
reviews.comment:
super easy to install, and Arctic continues to prove why they’re one of the best choices for PC fans. The build quality feels solid, and the fan runs strong without being overly loud.
The RGB looks clean and not overdone, and the included splitter makes setup even easier if you’re running multiple fans.
Overall, Arctic is always the way to go for PC cooling—reliable, efficient, and well worth it.
reviews.author: Hamza Ramić

reviews.title: 10/10 - Best Price to Performance Ratio You Can Find
reviews.comment: Amazing fans that as performant as you need with sane noise levels for every speed. Not to mention, they're extremely pretty and fit well into any argb system. Extremely good cost to performance ratio, these will effectively operate as well as a Noctua fan at less than half the price while also looking stylish. Easy to install as any other argb fan, and are the same models that they use in their Liquid Freezer III Pro AIOs (P14 for 280mm rad, P12 for 240/360mm rad). Highly recommended.
reviews.author: RPTroop
